    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    try:
        tau = float(tau_filter)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if np.isnan(tau) or np.isinf(tau) or tau < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Validate input arrays
    inputs = [
        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
        ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
        ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call),
    ]
    for name, arr in inputs:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2-dimensional")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (must be nonpositive)")

    # Check shape consistency
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, horizon = shape

    # Step T01: normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    if weight_sum == 0:
        raise ValueError("All weights are zero; horizon may be too large")
    norm_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Step T02: compute weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log prob)
    loss_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
    loss_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
    loss_with_result = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)

    # Step T03: stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Step T04: margin and threshold
    margins = L_minus - loss_with_result
    keep = margins >= tau

    return keep, margins
